story.title: Karnataka's ELEVATE NxT Deep-Tech Programme Draws 983 Applications, Nearly 23% From Outside State
story.summary: Karnataka's government-backed deep-tech startup programme ELEVATE NxT has received 983 applications, with 213 — nearly 23% — coming from startups outside the state, indicating national appetite for structured deep-tech support. The programme is designed to accelerate startups working on frontier technologies including AI, semiconductors, and advanced engineering. The strong cross-state response signals that India's deep-tech startup ecosystem is maturing beyond Bengaluru's traditional boundaries.
use_cases: cross-state innovation ecosystem building in India
